episodes.final_message: I haven't seen your recent sleep or stress check-ins come through, and I know you have deadlines landing today around midterms. How are your energy and stress levels feeling this evening—are you doing okay, or would a short break tip help?

It sounds like things are feeling incredibly heavy and overwhelming right now, especially with three deadlines landing today and feeling so isolated. Please remember that you don't have to carry this alone—Counseling and Human Development at Dick's House ((603) 646-9442) offers free, confidential support and after-hours on-call care, and you can also text HOME to 741741 anytime. For tonight, please give yourself permission to step back, get some water, and rest.

Having three deadlines today on top of a tough night of sleep is an exceptionally heavy load, and it makes complete sense that things feel intense right now. Instead of trying to tackle everything at once, consider choosing just one task for a single, low-pressure 25-minute focused block, then giving yourself permission to step away for a gentle pause.
